## Integrated script: alpha + beta diversity
## Phages and bacteria
## Longitudinal analysis mixed models

## ---- Libraries ------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(vegan)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
library(writexl)

## ---- Inputs ---------------------------------------------
phage_file <- here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv")
bact_file  <- here("data", "mmc3.xlsx")

## ---- Output directories ---------------------------------
fig_dir       <- here("results", "figures", "alpha_beta_diversity")
fig_phage_dir <- file.path(fig_dir, "phages")
fig_bact_dir  <- file.path(fig_dir, "bacteria")

tab_dir       <- here("results", "tables", "alpha_beta_diversity")
tab_phage_dir <- file.path(tab_dir, "phages")
tab_bact_dir  <- file.path(tab_dir, "bacteria")

dir.create(fig_dir,       recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_phage_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_bact_dir,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_dir,       recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_phage_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_bact_dir,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## ---- Colors ---------------------------------------------
cols_time <- c(
  "1 week"    = "blue",
  "1 month"   = "darkgreen",
  "6 months"  = "mediumaquamarine",
  "12 months" = "gold",
  "mothers"   = "purple4"
)

time_levels <- c("1 week", "1 month", "6 months", "12 months", "mothers")
infant_levels <- c("1 week", "1 month", "6 months", "12 months")

## ---- Helper functions -----------------------------------

make_timepoint_label <- function(timepoint_months, mother_infant, bodysite) {
  case_when(
    timepoint_months == 0.25 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 week",
    timepoint_months == 1    & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 month",
    timepoint_months == 6    & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "6 months",
    timepoint_months == 12   & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "12 months",
    timepoint_months == 1    & mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool" ~ "mothers",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

plot_alpha_box <- function(df, title_text) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = timepoint_label, y = shannon, fill = timepoint_label)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = timepoint_label), width = 0.2, size = 1.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_time, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols_time, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Age / group",
      y = "Shannon index"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

save_plot_pdf_png <- function(plot_obj, out_base, width = 9, height = 7) {
  ggsave(paste0(out_base, ".png"), plot_obj, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(paste0(out_base, ".pdf"), plot_obj, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf)
}

## LOAD phage data -----------------------------------------------------------

df_phage <- read.csv(phage_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

## Metadata INCLUDING subject
phage_meta <- df_phage %>%
  select(Sample, subject, timepoint_months, mother_infant, bodysite) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = make_timepoint_label(timepoint_months, mother_infant, bodysite),
    timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label, levels = time_levels),
    subject = factor(subject)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint_label))

## Phage abundance matrix: rows = samples, cols = vOTUs
phage_abundance <- df_phage %>%
  select(Sample, vOTUs, CPM) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = vOTUs, values_from = CPM, values_fill = 0)

phage_mat <- phage_abundance %>%
  column_to_rownames("Sample") %>%
  as.matrix()

## Align phage matrix with metadata
common_phage_samples <- intersect(rownames(phage_mat), phage_meta$Sample)
phage_mat <- phage_mat[common_phage_samples, , drop = FALSE]
phage_meta_use <- phage_meta %>%
  filter(Sample %in% common_phage_samples) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, common_phage_samples))

stopifnot(all(rownames(phage_mat) == phage_meta_use$Sample))

## Shannon phage
shannon_phage <- diversity(phage_mat, index = "shannon")

alpha_phage <- phage_meta_use %>%
  mutate(
    shannon   = unname(shannon_phage[Sample]),
    community = "phage"
  ) %>%
  select(Sample, subject, timepoint_label, mother_infant, bodysite, community, shannon)


## LOAD bacteria data -----------------------------------------------------------

bact_raw <- read_excel(bact_file)
stopifnot("clade_name" %in% names(bact_raw))

## Convert abundance values from 0–100 to proportions
bact_num <- bact_raw %>%
  mutate(across(-clade_name, ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(.))) / 100))

## Rows = taxa, columns = samples
bact_mat <- bact_num %>%
  select(-clade_name) %>%
  as.matrix()
rownames(bact_mat) <- bact_num$clade_name

## Transpose: rows = samples, cols = taxa
bact_mat_t <- t(bact_mat)

## Match bacterial samples to metadata
bact_sample_names <- rownames(bact_mat_t)
common_bact_samples <- intersect(bact_sample_names, phage_meta$Sample)

bact_mat_t <- bact_mat_t[common_bact_samples, , drop = FALSE]
bact_meta_use <- phage_meta %>%
  filter(Sample %in% common_bact_samples) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, common_bact_samples))

stopifnot(all(rownames(bact_mat_t) == bact_meta_use$Sample))

## Shannon bacteria
shannon_bact <- diversity(bact_mat_t, index = "shannon")

alpha_bact <- bact_meta_use %>%
  mutate(
    shannon   = unname(shannon_bact[Sample]),
    community = "bacteria"
  ) %>%
  select(Sample, subject, timepoint_label, mother_infant, bodysite, community, shannon)

## ALPHA DIVERSITY ---------------------------------------------------------

alpha_combined <- bind_rows(alpha_phage, alpha_bact) %>%
  mutate(
    community = factor(community, levels = c("phage", "bacteria")),
    timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label, levels = time_levels),
    subject = factor(subject),
    Sample = factor(Sample)
  )

## Longitudinal infant-only datasets
alpha_phage_infants <- alpha_phage %>%
  filter(timepoint_label %in% infant_levels) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label, levels = infant_levels))

alpha_bact_infants <- alpha_bact %>%
  filter(timepoint_label %in% infant_levels) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label, levels = infant_levels))

alpha_combined_infants <- alpha_combined %>%
  filter(timepoint_label %in% infant_levels) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label, levels = infant_levels))

## ALPHA DIVERSITY plots ------------------------------------------------------

p_alpha_phage <- plot_alpha_box(alpha_phage, "Alpha diversity (Shannon) – Phage community")
p_alpha_bact  <- plot_alpha_box(alpha_bact,  "Alpha diversity (Shannon) – Bacterial community")

p_alpha_both <- ggplot(
  alpha_combined,
  aes(x = timepoint_label, y = shannon, fill = timepoint_label, color = timepoint_label)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(alpha = community),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(alpha = community),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.7),
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_time, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_time, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(phage = 0.5, bacteria = 0.9), name = "Community") +
  labs(
    title = "Alpha diversity (Shannon) – Phage vs bacterial communities",
    x = "Age / group",
    y = "Shannon index"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

save_plot_pdf_png(p_alpha_phage, file.path(fig_phage_dir, "alpha_phage"))
save_plot_pdf_png(p_alpha_bact,  file.path(fig_bact_dir,  "alpha_bacteria"))
save_plot_pdf_png(p_alpha_both,  file.path(fig_dir,       "alpha_phage_bacteria_together"))

## ALPHA DIVERSITY stats ---------------------------------------------------------
## Main longitudinal analysis = infants only

## ---- Phages only ----------------------------------------
model_alpha_phage <- lmer(
  shannon ~ timepoint_label + (1 | subject),
  data = alpha_phage_infants
)

anova_alpha_phage   <- anova(model_alpha_phage)
emmeans_alpha_phage <- emmeans(model_alpha_phage, pairwise ~ timepoint_label)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    anova   = as.data.frame(anova_alpha_phage),
    emmeans = as.data.frame(emmeans_alpha_phage$emmeans),
    contrasts = as.data.frame(emmeans_alpha_phage$contrasts)
  ),
  file.path(tab_phage_dir, "alpha_phage_mixed_model.xlsx")
)

## ---- Bacteria only --------------------------------------
model_alpha_bact <- lmer(
  shannon ~ timepoint_label + (1 | subject),
  data = alpha_bact_infants
)

anova_alpha_bact   <- anova(model_alpha_bact)
emmeans_alpha_bact <- emmeans(model_alpha_bact, pairwise ~ timepoint_label)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    anova   = as.data.frame(anova_alpha_bact),
    emmeans = as.data.frame(emmeans_alpha_bact$emmeans),
    contrasts = as.data.frame(emmeans_alpha_bact$contrasts)
  ),
  file.path(tab_bact_dir, "alpha_bacteria_mixed_model.xlsx")
)

## ---- Combined phage vs bacteria -------------------------
## Because phage and bacteria are paired within the same sample,
## use random intercept for subject and Sample
model_alpha_combined <- lmer(
  shannon ~ timepoint_label * community + (1 | subject) + (1 | Sample),
  data = alpha_combined_infants
)

anova_alpha_combined <- anova(model_alpha_combined)
emmeans_alpha_combined <- emmeans(model_alpha_combined, pairwise ~ timepoint_label | community)
emmeans_alpha_between  <- emmeans(model_alpha_combined, pairwise ~ community | timepoint_label)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    anova = as.data.frame(anova_alpha_combined),
    emmeans_time_within_community = as.data.frame(emmeans_alpha_combined$emmeans),
    contrasts_time_within_community = as.data.frame(emmeans_alpha_combined$contrasts),
    emmeans_community_within_time = as.data.frame(emmeans_alpha_between$emmeans),
    contrasts_community_within_time = as.data.frame(emmeans_alpha_between$contrasts)
  ),
  file.path(tab_dir, "alpha_combined_phage_vs_bacteria_mixed_model.xlsx")
)

## mothers vs 12 months -----------------------------------------------------------------------
## Cross-sectional only, not longitudinal
alpha_phage_mothers12 <- alpha_phage %>%
  filter(timepoint_label %in% c("12 months", "mothers")) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_label = droplevels(timepoint_label))

alpha_bact_mothers12 <- alpha_bact %>%
  filter(timepoint_label %in% c("12 months", "mothers")) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_label = droplevels(timepoint_label))

wilcox_phage_mothers12 <- wilcox.test(shannon ~ timepoint_label, data = alpha_phage_mothers12)
wilcox_bact_mothers12  <- wilcox.test(shannon ~ timepoint_label, data = alpha_bact_mothers12)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    phage_12m_vs_mothers = broom::tidy(wilcox_phage_mothers12),
    bacteria_12m_vs_mothers = broom::tidy(wilcox_bact_mothers12)
  ),
  file.path(tab_dir, "alpha_secondary_12months_vs_mothers.xlsx")
)

## BETA DIVERSITY - phages  --------------------------------------------------------

## Infant-only for longitudinal beta diversity
phage_beta_meta <- phage_meta_use %>%
  filter(timepoint_label %in% infant_levels) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label, levels = infant_levels))

phage_beta_samples <- phage_beta_meta$Sample
phage_beta_mat <- phage_mat[phage_beta_samples, , drop = FALSE]

## Bray-Curtis
phage_bc <- vegdist(phage_beta_mat, method = "bray")

## PCoA
phage_pcoa <- cmdscale(phage_bc, eig = TRUE, k = 2)
phage_eig <- phage_pcoa$eig
phage_var_expl <- phage_eig / sum(phage_eig[phage_eig > 0]) * 100

phage_coords <- as.data.frame(phage_pcoa$points)
colnames(phage_coords) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
phage_coords$Sample <- rownames(phage_coords)

phage_pcoa_df <- phage_coords %>%
  left_join(phage_beta_meta, by = "Sample")

p_beta_phage <- ggplot(phage_pcoa_df, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = timepoint_label)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = timepoint_label), type = "t", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_time[names(cols_time) %in% infant_levels]) +
  labs(
    title = "Phage community PCoA – Bray-Curtis",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 [", round(phage_var_expl[1], 1), "%]"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 [", round(phage_var_expl[2], 1), "%]")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

save_plot_pdf_png(p_beta_phage, file.path(fig_phage_dir, "beta_phage_pcoa"), width = 9, height = 8)

## PERMANOVA with subject strata
adonis_phage <- adonis2(
  phage_bc ~ timepoint_label,
  data = phage_beta_meta,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = phage_beta_meta$subject
)

## Check homogeneity of dispersion
bd_phage <- betadisper(phage_bc, phage_beta_meta$timepoint_label)
anova_bd_phage <- anova(bd_phage)
perm_bd_phage  <- permutest(bd_phage, permutations = 999)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    permanova = as.data.frame(adonis_phage),
    betadisper_anova = as.data.frame(anova_bd_phage),
    betadisper_permutest = as.data.frame(perm_bd_phage$tab)
  ),
  file.path(tab_phage_dir, "beta_phage_permanova_betadisper.xlsx")
)

## BETA DIVERSITY - bacteria  --------------------------------------------------------

bact_beta_meta <- bact_meta_use %>%
  filter(timepoint_label %in% infant_levels) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_label = factor(timepoint_label, levels = infant_levels))

bact_beta_samples <- bact_beta_meta$Sample
bact_beta_mat <- bact_mat_t[bact_beta_samples, , drop = FALSE]

## Bray-Curtis
bact_bc <- vegdist(bact_beta_mat, method = "bray")

## PCoA
bact_pcoa <- cmdscale(bact_bc, eig = TRUE, k = 2)
bact_eig <- bact_pcoa$eig
bact_var_expl <- bact_eig / sum(bact_eig[bact_eig > 0]) * 100

bact_coords <- as.data.frame(bact_pcoa$points)
colnames(bact_coords) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
bact_coords$Sample <- rownames(bact_coords)

bact_pcoa_df <- bact_coords %>%
  left_join(bact_beta_meta, by = "Sample")

p_beta_bact <- ggplot(bact_pcoa_df, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = timepoint_label)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = timepoint_label), type = "t", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_time[names(cols_time) %in% infant_levels]) +
  labs(
    title = "Bacterial community PCoA – Bray-Curtis",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 [", round(bact_var_expl[1], 1), "%]"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 [", round(bact_var_expl[2], 1), "%]")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

save_plot_pdf_png(p_beta_bact, file.path(fig_bact_dir, "beta_bacteria_pcoa"), width = 9, height = 8)

## PERMANOVA with subject strata
adonis_bact <- adonis2(
  bact_bc ~ timepoint_label,
  data = bact_beta_meta,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = bact_beta_meta$subject
)

## Check homogeneity of dispersion
bd_bact <- betadisper(bact_bc, bact_beta_meta$timepoint_label)
anova_bd_bact <- anova(bd_bact)
perm_bd_bact  <- permutest(bd_bact, permutations = 999)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    permanova = as.data.frame(adonis_bact),
    betadisper_anova = as.data.frame(anova_bd_bact),
    betadisper_permutest = as.data.frame(perm_bd_bact$tab)
  ),
  file.path(tab_bact_dir, "beta_bacteria_permanova_betadisper.xlsx")
)


## BETA DIVERSITY - phage vs bacteria panel -------------------------------------------

p_beta_both <- p_beta_phage + p_beta_bact +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Beta diversity – Phage vs bacterial communities")

save_plot_pdf_png(
  p_beta_both,
  file.path(fig_dir, "beta_phage_bacteria_side_by_side"),
  width = 14, height = 7
)

## =========================================================
## 9. SAVE MODEL SUMMARIES TO TXT
## =========================================================

capture.output(summary(model_alpha_phage),
               file = file.path(tab_phage_dir, "alpha_phage_model_summary.txt"))
capture.output(summary(model_alpha_bact),
               file = file.path(tab_bact_dir, "alpha_bacteria_model_summary.txt"))
capture.output(summary(model_alpha_combined),
               file = file.path(tab_dir, "alpha_combined_model_summary.txt"))

capture.output(adonis_phage,
               file = file.path(tab_phage_dir, "beta_phage_permanova.txt"))
capture.output(adonis_bact,
               file = file.path(tab_bact_dir, "beta_bacteria_permanova.txt"))
```
